boundaries.name: rust_compiler_and_plonky2_lowering
boundaries.obligation: Handwritten data/controlflow/relations and operation traces are not a machine-checked refinement of Rust allocation, field arithmetic, gates, optimization, witness generators, compiler, or proof serialization.

boundaries.name: keccak_and_poseidon
boundaries.obligation: Concrete domain-separated Keccak/Poseidon implementations and relation lowering remain unproved; local compared-preimage binding assumptions do not assert impossible universal finite-hash injectivity.

boundaries.name: canonical_poseidon_output
boundaries.obligation: Circuit reduce-to-field plus safe-split encode-back is modeled separately from native raw TryFrom; canonical encoding gadget refinement and hash-output field canonicality remain dependencies.

boundaries.name: merkle_authentication
boundaries.obligation: Path-fold computation and bit order are represented; indexed-tree storage history and collision-resistant authentication of a reference leaf/path are explicit scoped obligations.

boundaries.name: decryption_core_arithmetic
boundaries.obligation: decryption_gadget.rs internal canonical coefficient, nonzero, ternary secret, quotient, wrap, noise, digit/carry and high-bit equations plus native builder correctness are not discharged; typed exact arguments and amount connects only are proved locally.

boundaries.name: native_writer_and_panics
boundaries.obligation: Native u32/u64 casts, from_canonical field checks, partial witness conflicts/unwraps, path shape assertions, allocation and generated assignment interpretation remain call dependencies with panic outcomes.

boundaries.name: consumer_finality_and_replay
boundaries.obligation: Latest finalized H1/current close digest, signature authority, registry membership, source import history, unclaimed/nullifier state and remaining funds must be checked by consumer; this circuit alone establishes none of those global properties.

boundaries.name: proof_backend_soundness
boundaries.obligation: Backend prove/verify and wrapping do not become sound merely because the modeled local relation is satisfiable; examples use explicit dependency stubs, not real proof execution.
